title: Top-degree abelian class eventually vanishes near closed complement
statement: For a Noetherian spectral space of dimension at most d, every degree-d abelian cohomology class on an open vanishes after restriction to the intersection with a quasi-compact neighborhood of its closed complement.

source.place: Tag 0A3G, label proposition-cohomological-dimension-spectral (2), for the spectral underlying space of a Noetherian scheme and the underlying abelian sheaf; module cohomology agrees with underlying abelian-sheaf cohomology by Tag 01F1 (lemma-modules-abelian); restriction is k-linear by naturality of derived global sections

proof.text: The punctured-generalization subspace has dimension at most d-1; noetherian cohomology vanishing kills its degree-d cohomology, and the filtered colimit comparison gives eventual vanishing.
